either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong winds,
low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can contribute to
extreme fire behavior.

lightning. Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover.

windows.

enough to be struck by lightning. Move to safe shelter now! Do not be
caught on the water in a thunderstorm.

Monday morning through Monday evening.

local land management agencies.

are forecast to occur. Listen for later forecasts and possible
Red Flag Warnings.
